summary: Comprehensive testing of 5 critical bug fixes completed. All backend API tests passed (9/9). Frontend UI verified for Edit/Delete buttons on pending leaves and 'Rejected' option in approval dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 (Working Hours Duplicate): POST /api/work-entries correctly checks for existing entry with same employee+date+project and updates instead of creating duplicate. Hours are accumulated and work details are appended with separator.
Bug Fix 2 (Leave Edit): PUT /api/leaves/applications/{id} endpoint works correctly for pending applications. Returns 400 if application is already processed.
Bug Fix 3 (Leave Delete): DELETE /api/leaves/applications/{id} endpoint works correctly for pending applications. Returns 400 if application is already processed.
Bug Fix 4 (Partial Approval): Admin approval dialog shows 'Rejected' option (in red) for individual dates. When some dates are approved and some rejected, status becomes 'partial'.
Bug Fix 5 (Late Count): Employee dashboard uses max(0, completed_count - late_count) to prevent negative on_time values. Late count shows 0 correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created test leave application for Edit/Delete verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 bug fixes verified working: 1) Work entry POST updates existing entry for same employee+date+project, 2) Employee can edit pending leave via PUT endpoint, 3) Employee can delete pending leave via DELETE endpoint, 4) Admin approval dialog has 'Rejected' option for per-date rejection creating 'partial' status, 5) Late count never negative due to max(0, ...) protection.

Bug Fix 1 - Working Hours Duplicate Entr.details: POST /api/work-entries updates existing entry instead of creating duplicate. Hours accumulated (4+3=7), work details appended with separator.

Bug Fix 2 - Leave Application Edit.details: PUT /api/leaves/applications/{id} works for pending applications. Edit button visible in UI. Returns 400 after approval.

Bug Fix 3 - Leave Application Delete.details: DELETE /api/leaves/applications/{id} works for pending applications. Delete button visible in UI. Returns 400 after approval.

Bug Fix 4 - Partial Approval/Rejection.details: Admin approval dialog shows 'Rejected' option (red) in dropdown. Partial approval creates status='partial' when some dates approved, some rejected.

Bug Fix 5 - Late Count Not Negative.details: Employee dashboard shows Late: 0 (not negative). max(0, completed_count - late_count) protection verified in code and API response.

Project Status Sync.details: All projects have valid status fields (ongoing, completed, late, active, on-hold, cancelled). is_late flag is boolean.

PUT Endpoint Exists.details: PUT /api/leaves/applications/{id} returns 404 for non-existent ID (not 405), confirming endpoint exists.

DELETE Endpoint Exists.details: DELETE /api/leaves/applications/{id} returns 404 for non-existent ID (not 405), confirming endpoint exists.
